system.description:
An ancient Gangrel power — controversial even among the clan, who see it as a denial of the truth of the Beast — that lets a vampire temporarily suppress the animal features accumulated from frenzy, reverting to a semblance of her mortal likeness. The extent of the reversion is unreliable.

System: The player spends three Blood Traits and makes a Willpower Test. Each success hides a number of bestial features (one success hides one feature, two hide four, three hide nine, four hide sixteen). Hidden features remain concealed for the scene or until the vampire frenzies. The vampire also regains one lost Social Trait per success for the duration.
system.source: Libellus Sanguinis III: Wolves at the Door, Book One: Animals
